overall_summary: Analysis of the data reveals clear outperformance in husband-wife relationship dynamics (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,768 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,676 views), significantly outperforming general sad shayari or broader family dynamics like sister/brother videos which had low sample views. The audience strongly engages with nuanced marital/relationship realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,768 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,676 views) massively outperformed all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dynamics, expectations after marriage, and silent compromises between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: Using a poignant question in the title ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') successfully drives higher click-through and viewership.
winning_patterns.action: Formulate titles as thought-provoking, relatable questions about everyday emotional friction.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on sisters ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') yielded very low views (19 and 139 views).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize sibling content for now and focus heavily on romantic/marital relationships and personal overthinking.

weak_patterns.evidence: Abstract poetry titles like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 20 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic rants; ground the content in observable real-life situations.
